s: December 12, 2024 - Can you visualize how the art would look in their home? Art is meant to be displayed, so consider the style, colors, and themes throughout their home, including any other artwork they may have. Ask yourself for what space this gift is intended. For example, if they just bought a house, remodeled a bathroom, designed a new office space, having a space in mind helps focus your options.
